crossRefs.note: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’…

translations.web: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’
translations.bsb: But He replied, “When evening comes, you say, ‘The weather will be fair, for the sky is red,’
translations.kjv: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
translations.asv: But he answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the heaven is red.
